supervisor.value: Students choose a research advisor during the first year, by the end of Fall quarter.
supervisor.quote: The choice of a research advisor among the Department faculty is likely to be the most important decision a student makes during the first year of graduate study.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are guaranteed support while in good standing and making progress.
funding.quote: All students admitted into our Ph.D. program are guaranteed financial support.

entry_route.value: The program is doctoral only; an M.S. on the way to the PhD is not required.
entry_route.quote: Please remember that receiving an M.S. on the way to the Ph.D. is not a requirement in the UCSB Materials Department.

notes: Department says desirable TOEFL is 100 and IELTS 8, but the minimum is the UCSB minimum.
